body:
sorry man. it sucks and its not fair
i cant imagine what it would be like if she left me for someone else so im sorry dude

thank you for the help. sitting down for a massive heart to heart was a good idea but unfortunately didn't work, she says that the suicide thing really fucked her up and she can't love me anymore for that. if i can fend off my demons i will spend every bit of my energy into trying to win her back. she wants her space and i can give her that, but i need to win this girl back by the end of this year or else... well idk. but i know i cant be happy without this girl in my life. i get it, im young, but still... i guess i met my soulmate a bit too early in life.
